evidence.summary: Header comment states JWT bearer tokens, posts publish immediately, anonymous posting allowed.
login checks email/password and returns a JWT with sub and role claims, signed with a hard-coded literal key.
GET /api/posts/<int:post_id> returns {id: int, body: str, author_id: int or None}; no auth check.
POST /api/posts: without a token the post is anonymous and published at once.
create_post raises ValueError when body exceeds 10000 characters.
users: integer id, email, name, role in (user, admin).
posts: integer id, nullable author_id (null = anonymous), body max 10000, created_at; no status column.
MIT licence text permitting use without restriction.

frontend: unknown (only a list of client routes)
backend: Python with PyJWT (import jwt); web framework not shown
database: SQL-style tables documented in comments; engine unknown

architecture.backend: plain functions mapped to routes in a ROUTES dict; db helper not in the folder

features.name: Token sign-in (JWT bearer)
features.description: A user signs in with email and password and receives a JWT bearer token carrying user id and role.
features.observed_behaviour: POST /api/token calls db.check(email, password) and returns {token}.
features.business_logic: Token claims: sub, role. Signing key is a hard-coded literal (security weakness; no expiry claim).
features.integration: needs a signing secret from configuration, not code

features.name: Read a post (public)
features.description: Anyone opens a single post by integer id.
features.observed_behaviour: GET /api/posts/<int> returns {id, body, author_id}; no token needed.

features.name: Create a post (published immediately)
features.description: A user writes a post of up to 10000 characters; it is visible at once.
features.observed_behaviour: POST /api/posts inserts the post; no status or review step.
features.business_logic: Body max 10000 chars, ValueError above that; no moderation.

features.name: Anonymous posting
features.description: Posting without signing in; the post has no author.
features.observed_behaviour: With no token, author_id is None and the post is published at once.

features.name: Post list screen
features.observed_behaviour: Only the client route is listed; no list endpoint in ROUTES.

workflows.name: Sign in and post
edge_cases: invalid token on create (decode error, handling unknown)

auth.session: stateless JWT bearer token (no expiry seen)
auth.model: roles user, admin carried in the token; no role checks seen in the API

configuration.purpose: signs tokens; currently a hard-coded literal in api.py and must move to configuration (value not copied)

error_handling.case: invalid or expired token on create

unknowns: Web framework and HTTP error mapping are not shown; db helper (db.check, db.get, db.insert) not in the folder.
Password storage and hashing are unknown.
What the admin role can do: no admin endpoints or checks exist in the folder.
